She slowly breaks into a small, gentle smile and holds it, still looking into the lens, while the background keeps sliding past behind her from right to left.

nodes.title: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Wan → HDR Workflow for Radiance:

Text or image to video with Wan 2.2 (14B or 5B) or Wan 2.1, into an EXR master.
- **Image to video**: turn on "First Frame" (and "Last Frame"), and load Wan 2.2 14B's i2v files.
- **Turbo**: turn on "Turbo LoRA": 4 steps instead of 20.
- **HDR**: SDR to HDR Universal is set to Expand, the math path (Video Frames, adaptive knee, temporal smoothing): fast and steady over the shot. Set mode to Hybrid to have RUDRA ACES 2 rebuild every frame instead (slower; frames are reconstructed one by one). Without RUDRA (not installed, downloads off) Hybrid keeps the math path: the node's report output says which one ran.
- **Outputs**: EXR 16-bit half sequence (master), HDR10 MP4 (H.265 10-bit PQ) and SDR MP4 via ACES 2.0 for review, and a contact sheet PNG. The MP4s and the contact sheet are bypassed: select their group, then Ctrl+B.
- **Viewer**: the HDR master against the SDR decode.

- Radiance: [Documentation](https://www.fxtdstudios.com/comfyu-radiance-docs/)
- Radiance: [GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance)

## Radiance Report Issues :
To report any issues with Radiance nodes, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance/issues)

## Model Links (for Local Users)

Pick the files in the Loader: the Sampler, in "Auto", follows them. The files go in `ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models`, `loras`, `text_encoders` and `vae`.

- text_encoders: [umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors) (used)

**Wan 2.2 5B** (text or image to video, 24 fps, "Resolution" on WAN TI2V (48ch), 1280x704 or more)
- diffusion_models: [wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp16](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/wan2.2_ti2v_5B_fp16.safetensors)
- vae: [wan2.2_vae](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/vae/wan2.2_vae.safetensors)

**Wan 2.1** (text to video, 16 fps)
- diffusion_models: [wan2.1_t2v_1.3B_fp16](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/wan2.1_t2v_1.3B_fp16.safetensors), [wan2.1_t2v_14B_fp8_scaled](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/wan2.1_t2v_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors)

## Model Storage Location (loaded files)

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   ├── wan2.2_t2v_high_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│   │   └── wan2.2_t2v_low_noise_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors
│   └── 📂 vae/
│       └── wan_2.1_vae.safetensors
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)

nodes.title: Note: AI Fill
widgets_values:
**AI Fill** (optional: select the group, then Ctrl+B):
- Draws the inside of fully clipped highlights (sun, lamps, a white sky) that "SDR → HDR Universal" leaves flat, and sets their brightness (up to 3 stops above the master).
- Plausible, not recovered. The SDR view does not change: only the HDR master gains detail. With nothing clipped, it changes nothing.
- First run: downloads about 8 GB into models/radiance (RUDRA AI fill v3 and Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B). Needs about 16 GB of VRAM.
- "prompt_highlight": what to draw (e.g. "soft clouds in a bright blue sky"). Empty uses RUDRA's own prompt; a custom one loads an 11 GB text encoder once.
- Video: the frames go through in overlapping 33-frame windows, so a long shot takes a while.

nodes.title: Note: Turbo LoRA
widgets_values:
**Turbo LoRA** (optional: select the group, then Ctrl+B):
- lightx2v's 4-step LoRA: pick its high_noise file, the "Loader" puts its low_noise file on the low-noise expert.
- The "Sampler", in "Auto", sees it and runs 4 steps at CFG 1.
- Image to video: pick the i2v pair.

nodes.title: Note: First and Last Frame
widgets_values:
**First and Last Frame** (optional: select a group, then Ctrl+B):
- Both off: Text to Video. "First Frame" on: Image to Video. Both on: the shot goes from one image to the other. "Last Frame" alone: the shot ends on it.
- Wan 2.2 14B: load its i2v files in the "Loader". The 5B reads the first frame only.
- The "Resolution" follows the Loader: WAN (16ch) at 16 fps for Wan 2.2 14B and Wan 2.1, WAN TI2V (48ch) at 24 fps for the 5B.
